subject.title: fix: expose wedged overflow sessions to recovery tooling

question: Should `lastBlockedRun` become the core-owned durable marker for exhausted embedded-agent context-overflow recovery, or should this PR wait for auto-rotation/replay design?
rationale: The PR chooses a persistent session-state contract and reserves a plugin projection key for a linked issue already marked as needing product direction.

options.title: Accept marker-first recovery
options.body: Proceed with the durable marker after real behavior proof and compatibility review confirm the upgrade path is acceptable.

options.title: Rename or namespace the marker
options.body: Keep the approach but adjust the persisted field shape if maintainers do not want a globally reserved `lastBlockedRun` slot.

options.title: Pause for auto-rotation design
options.body: Keep the linked issue canonical and defer this PR if one-shot rotation and replay safety are the desired first implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept marker-first recovery
recommendation.body: Proceed with the durable marker after real behavior proof and compatibility review confirm the upgrade path is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is primarily about durable session-state shape and recovery policy, and this account has the strongest recent history in that area.
